Since the deliverable is real purity, I should fit a model to “corrected” experimental data: treat values below some threshold as biased low and adjust them upward using the lab comparison, then fit a smooth mean-vs-T and residual SD. # Simple empirical correction from lab comparison:

coef = np.polyfit(exp_df["T"], exp_df["y_corr"], 2)

print(coef)

pred = np.polyval(coef, exp_df["T"])
resid = exp_df["y_corr"] - pred
print("\nresidual summary")
